name: Blender Skills (94 agent skills for Blender MCP)
summary: Open-source pack of 94 specialist Blender skills (175+ references) for Cursor, Claude Code, Kiro and Codex. Through the BlenderMCP addon, the agent runs a production pipeline directly in Blender: blockout, hard-surface, UVs, materials, rigging, animation, LODs, collision proxies and export to Unity, Unreal and Godot.

access.notes: Needs a local Blender plus the BlenderMCP addon (ahujasid/blender-mcp) and uv. Claude marketplace listing still under review; install from GitHub. Last pushed July 2026.

procedure: Install uv and the BlenderMCP addon in Blender
In Blender press N → BlenderMCP → Connect
Copy the skills dir for your client (.cursor/skills, .claude/skills, Kiro or Codex skills path) and the MCP config
Restart the agent and start with the blender-director skill

verdict.why: MIT, ~1.4k stars, broad coverage of a real game-asset pipeline with engine exports. It's a prompt/skill pack on top of BlenderMCP, not assets, and quality depends on the agent; viral reposts but the repo itself is the primary page.
